products.name: Atelier Jar — Screw Jar
products.shortDescription: Hand-poured natural soy wax housed in a luxurious glass jar with an elegant screw lid.
products.fullDescription: The Atelier Jar is the quintessential expression of Immerse Lume craftsmanship. Poured by hand with pure soy wax and blended with botanical fragrance oils, this 210g candle provides an even, clean burn for up to 40 hours. The tactile screw lid preserves fragrance intensity between uses and doubles as a heat-resistant pedestal.
careInstructions: Trim cotton wick to 5mm before every lighting.
Allow the wax pool to reach the glass edge on the first burn (approx 2-3 hours).
Do not burn continuously for longer than 4 hours.
Place on a stable, heat-resistant surface away from drafts.

products.name: Cascade Jar — Line Jar
products.shortDescription: Refined vertical linear fluted glass casting delicate shadow plays as it burns.
products.fullDescription: The Cascade Jar captures architectural modernism through elegant vertical ribbing. When lit, the luminous flame projects soothing linear patterns across interior surfaces. Blended with artisanal botanicals and natural soy wax for 30 hours of continuous sensory elevation.
careInstructions: Trim wick to 5mm before each use.
Burn on heat-safe surfaces.
Keep wax pool free of wick trimmings and foreign materials.

products.name: Stardust Jar — Sparkle Jar
products.shortDescription: Sparkle glass candle that shimmers with celestial luminescence when lit.
products.fullDescription: Designed for celebrations and enchanting evenings, the Stardust Jar features an ethereal sparkle glass finish. The candlelight gently reflects off microscopic golden and metallic pigments, creating a warm, ambient warmth that transforms any living space into a tranquil sanctuary.
careInstructions: Allow wax to melt completely across top surface.
Wipe the exterior gently with a dry microfibre cloth.
Extinguish with a candle snuffer to prevent smoke.

products.name: Lustre Bowl — Small Urli
products.shortDescription: Traditional hammered metal urli re-imagined as an opulent artisanal scented candle.
products.fullDescription: Paying homage to timeless Indian metalworking traditions, the Lustre Bowl is handcrafted in lustrous polished metals. Filled with golden soy wax and steeped in pure fragrance extracts, this statement urli candle serves as an exquisite centrepiece for meaningful rituals and serene living spaces.
careInstructions: Vessel becomes warm during use; handle with care.
Place upon the included felt base or a coaster.
Re-use the solid metal bowl after candle life.

products.name: Mandala Tin
products.shortDescription: Ornately embossed mandala tins with matching decorative lids in three intricate motifs.
products.fullDescription: The Mandala Tin is a celebration of sacred geometry and intricate Indian decorative artistry. Available in three captivating designs, each tin is sealed with an airtight lid, making it portable and travel-friendly while safeguarding the delicate natural essential oils inside.
careInstructions: Secure lid when not in use to preserve fragrance freshness.
Never burn unattended.
Repurpose tin as a jewellery or trinket keepsake.

products.name: Aroma Reed Diffuser
products.shortDescription: Apothecary amber bottle with natural rattan reeds delivering effortless, continuous scent.
products.fullDescription: For spaces that deserve an understated, constant fragrance presence without an open flame. Formulated with an alcohol-free, slow-evaporating diffuser base and saturated with our signature concentrated oils. Includes 8 porous rattan reeds.
products.vessel: Apothecary glass bottle with natural reeds
careInstructions: Flip reeds once a week for renewed fragrance vibrancy.
Place in high-airflow areas for broad scent throw.

products.name: Pure Fragrance Dropper Oil
products.shortDescription: Pure botanical fragrance concentrate with precision glass dropper for ultrasonic diffusers.
products.fullDescription: Our purest distillation of signature Immerse Lume accords. A few drops into an ultrasonic mist diffuser or oil burner immediately infuses large living areas with soothing, transportive aroma.
careInstructions: Add 5-8 drops to water in ultrasonic diffusers.
Store in a cool place away from direct sunlight.

products.name: Bespoke Signature Gift Box
products.shortDescription: Couture ivory presentation box adorned with gold foil embossing and raw silk ribbons.
products.fullDescription: Crafted for weddings, corporate gifting, and intimate milestone celebrations. The Bespoke Signature Gift Box presents a curated duet or quartet of Immerse Lume candles and diffusers, enveloped in weighted tissue and sealed with our insignia wax seal.
careInstructions: Includes dedicated candle care handbook and bespoke gift card.

fragrances.name: Crimson Canopy
fragrances.subTitle: Saffron Sandal
fragrances.tagline: The warmth of spice. The richness of wood.
fragrances.description: A luxurious fragrance that captures the golden intensity of saffron resting over creamy sandalwood. Soft floral nuances add refinement, while amber and musk create a warm, lingering finish.

fragrances.name: Petals in the Hearth
fragrances.subTitle: Rose & Oudh
fragrances.tagline: Where delicate florals meet smoky warmth.
fragrances.description: Inspired by crimson rose petals resting beside a glowing fireplace, this evocative fragrance brings together the romantic softness of rose and the deep, resinous character of oudh.

fragrances.name: White Garland
fragrances.subTitle: Arabian Jasmine
fragrances.tagline: A garland of flowers, captured in fragrance.
fragrances.description: Inspired by traditional mogra garlands and the beauty of floral adornment, White Garland celebrates the luminous elegance of Arabian jasmine sambac. Dewy green notes and sheer neroli lend a fresh, delicate quality.

fragrances.name: Orchid Pod
fragrances.subTitle: Warm Vanilla
fragrances.tagline: The irresistible warmth of golden vanilla.
fragrances.description: An indulgent fragrance built around sun-cured vanilla, golden tonka and dark amber. Smooth and enveloping, it creates a comforting sense of warmth.

sections.title: The Art of Living in the Moment
sections.subTitle: Immerse Lume Luxury Fragrance
sections.content: Discover the art of fragrance, thoughtfully crafted to transform everyday spaces into extraordinary experiences.

sections.title: Our Philosophy
sections.subTitle: Elevate Every Moment
sections.content: At Immerse Lume, we believe that fragrance has the power to transform a space, evoke emotions and turn everyday rituals into cherished experiences. Inspired by the beauty of nature, the warmth of meaningful moments and the timeless appeal of elegant design, we create scented candles that bring together captivating fragrances and beautiful glass vessels.
sections.secondaryContent: Our philosophy is simple: create fragrances that inspire you to pause, breathe and immerse yourself in the present.

sections.title: Create Moments Worth Remembering
sections.subTitle: Lifestyle Editorial
sections.content: Whether welcoming guests into your home, winding down at twilight, or gifting someone an unforgettable gesture of affection, Immerse Lume creates an atmospheric sanctuary of warmth and tranquility.

sections.title: Immerse Yourself in the Extraordinary.
sections.subTitle: Immerse Lume
sections.content: Handcrafted natural soy wax candles and botanical diffusers created with quiet sophistication and artistic purpose.
